messages:
Maya (eng-platform): Quick note — we're seeing a rising class of 413s from clients sending high-dim arrays in a single request. My proposal: add a soft 'shape hint' in the 413 response + a small response header that suggests a retry/backoff split plan so SDKs can auto-split and retry instead of surfacing raw 413s to customers.

Chris (runtime): +1 to an SDK-guidance field. Question: header vs response body? headers are easier for proxies but body is more expressive.

Maya (eng-platform): Leaning body because we want structured info (chunks, max_chunk_bytes, preferred_dim_slice). Example payload I sketched: 
```json
{
  "error": "request_too_large",
  "hint": {
    "chunks": 2,
    "method": "by_bytes",
    "max_chunk_bytes": 1048576,
    "preferred_dim_slice": [0, 1024]
  }
}
```

Jordan (console): From UX/console side — we need telemetry to measure: 1) how often hint is emitted, 2) how often SDKs actually follow the hint (apply+retry), and 3) downstream success after retry. Plan: new telemetry events `embed_hint_emitted`, `embed_hint_applied`, `embed_retry_success`. Also add a dashboard tile for hint adoption rate.

Tess (infra): Important: this changes quota semantics. If a client auto-splits and retries, we may double-count tokens/units. We should decide whether to bill the original request or the aggregate of chunks. Also we need to ensure burst protections don't falsely trigger when SDK does quick retries.

Sam (eng-platform): For billing I'd prefer counting only successful served chunks; but that might be surprising. Alternative: mark auto-retry path as "client-assisted-split" and send a flag so billing pipeline can attribute to a single logical request id.

Chris (runtime): Pragmatically, implementing a `suggested_split_plan` in body is straightforward. Runtime will emit it when we detect a size-to-dim mismatch and we have an available splitter heuristic. We'll attach `X-Embed-Hint-Version: 1` header too for backward compatibility.

Maya (eng-platform): SDK owners want a minimal surface: if we get `hint` + `retryable:true`, SDK auto-splits and retries with exponential backoff and jitter. If server returns `retryable:false` then SDK should surface error.

Jordan (console): Rollout: canary 10% of tenants, toggle in console with an opt-out. Console should show per-tenant adoption metrics and a flag to view raw hint payloads for a tenant.

Tess (infra): Telemetry: we must include `logical_request_id` in all events so billing + observability can correlate original request -> chunks. Also add a rate-limit dampening window for auto-retries so we don't amplify spikes.

Sam (eng-platform): Edge case: mixed-dim batches (some 128d, some 6144d). Hint should include per-item guidance (index-based) instead of global chunking where necessary. That complicates SDKs but is doable if we add `per_item`: [{"idx":3,"chunks":3}] in hint.

Chris (runtime): We'll need a small change to the preflight layer to compute hints without full parsing overhead. Could be best-effort and only emitted for common patterns. We'll also add a `hint_confidence` score (low/med/high) so SDKs can decide whether to auto-split.

Maya (eng-platform): Action items:
- Chris: prototype hint in runtime and emit `embed_hint_emitted` (canary).
- Jordan: dashboard tile + adoption metric `hint_adoption_rate`.
- Tess: design billing attribution and retry dampening; propose accounting in PR.
- Sam: update SDKs to interpret `hint` + `hint_confidence` and implement safe auto-split.

splitter-bot: Created issue RFC #1127: "embed-hint-and-auto-split-sdk-flow" and assigned to Chris/Sam/Jordan/Tess.

Maya (eng-platform): Can we aim for a small canary next week (10% traffic) and then grad expand if telemetry looks good?

Chris (runtime): Yup, will push a canary flag. I'll include logs for `hint_emitted` with sample counts.

Jordan (console): I'll add the console flag and a per-tenant adoption chart. Set me as owner for rollout dashboard.

Tess (infra): I'll write the billing proposal by EOD Wednesday. Note: need legal sign-off if we change billable event model.

Sam (eng-platform): SDK PR drafted. Will wire `hint_confidence` mapping to auto-split thresholds.

Maya (eng-platform): Awesome — new plan looks actionable. Will follow up with a short spec in the RFC thread. :thumbsup:
